concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-in-person-get-started-1-account-structure]] - 2026-09-16 unversioned Braintree In-Person account-hierarchy guide for gateway account, Merchant Account ID and Location ID roles; its heading and introduction compare one MAID per store with one MAID for all or multiple stores, while its table labels the second model merchant account for each brand and gives country/brand-level consequences, so the labels are not interchangeable universal structures; final design requires account-specific PayPal engineering review, and account or Sandbox setup is not production enablement, current SDK support or payment-outcome proof
warnings: The source inconsistently labels its second comparison model: one MAID for all or multiple stores in the heading and prose, but merchant account for each brand in the table with country/brand-level consequences.
The source is a collected website snapshot and does not establish current availability or GitHub SDK/version support.
A designed or Sandbox account structure does not prove production enablement, reader-online state or a successful payment.
